syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in neuroscience research. Scientists study mice to learn about the brain. Mice are a good model because scientists can control them. 

Researchers often use male mice in experiments. They do this because female mice have a hormone cycle. This cycle can change behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification:
Mice are important in brain research. Scientists study mice to learn about how the brain works. Mice are a good choice because scientists can control them. 

Researchers often use boy mice in experiments. They do this because girl mice have a hormone cycle. This cycle can change behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are important in research about the brain. Scientists study mice to learn how the brain works. Mice are a good choice because scientists can control their surroundings and behavior.

Researchers often use boy mice in their studies. They do this because girl mice go through a cycle caused by hormones. Hormones are chemicals in the body that affect how you feel and act. This cycle can change how girl mice behave. These changes might affect the results of the experiments, making it harder to understand what the scientists are studying.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for the following target group: non-native English speakers with a beginner level of English. Rewrite the text in plain language to make it easily understandable for them.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
